textbookText: Proof: For two vectors to be parallel, their cross product should vanish. i.e., A⃗⃗⃗⃗ × B⃗⃗ =0 ⇒ (3î +4ĵ- 5k̂) × (3î +4ĵ- 5k̂) =12 k̂+15ĵ-12k̂-20î-15ĵ+20î=0 Hence the vectors show the case of parallelism.
Q: If vectors 𝐴⃗ and 𝐵⃗⃗ are non- zero vectors, is it possible for 𝐴⃗⃗⃗⃗ × 𝐵⃗⃗ and 𝐴⃗ .𝐵⃗⃗ both to be zero? Explain.

Ans: Here we have, A⃗⃗⃗⃗ × B⃗⃗ = ABsinθ𝑛̂ and for A⃗⃗⃗⃗ × B⃗⃗ to be zero sinθ = 0 i.e., the vectors should be parallel or antiparallel and for ⃗⃗A⃗⃗⃗. B⃗⃗ to be zero, ⃗⃗A⃗⃗⃗. B⃗⃗ = ABcosθ = ABcos900 =0 i.e., they should act at 900 to each other.
Test yourself: 1. Show that the magnitude of a cross product equals the area of a parallelogram formed by the vectors. 2. What is the angle between (𝐴⃗+𝐵⃗⃗) and 𝐴⃗⃗⃗⃗ × 𝐵⃗⃗ ? (Ans: 900)

Project Work: Project 2.1 Determining the Shortest Displacement from Home to Shop A shop lies 200 meters north to the main gate of the house, then 300 meters east, and finally 100 meters southeast. Hint: Materials: Graph paper (optional), Ruler, Calculator, Pen/pencil, Protractor, etc.

• Procedural steps: Start from the origin (0,0), the main gate, of the house. • Move 200 meters positive in Y-direction. • Then move 300 meters positive in X-direction to the east. • Finally, move 100 meters southeast, which is at a 45-degree angle to the south and

east. • Determine the coordinates after each movement: • From (0, 0) to (0,200) (200 meters north). • From (0,200) to (300,200) (300 meters east). • From (300,200) to the final point. • Resolve the southeast movement into x and y components. • Component of X =100cos450 = Component of Y = 70.7 For final coordinates: • The x-coordinate: 300+70.7=370.7300 + 70.7 =370.7= x • The y-coordinate: 200−70.7=129.3200 - 70.7 =129.3= y • The displacement vector, d = √𝑥2 + 𝑦2 Note: Select a similar task and execute it for the project work.
